name: self-improve
goal: Improve aflt's deterministic eval score with small, tested fixes. Never lower the baseline score. Never edit eval/RUBRIC.md or scripts/eval/score.js / scripts/eval/rubric.js.
acceptance: After at most 3 improve rounds (or earlier on score plateau): full suite green, score >= baseline, RUBRIC GUARD clean. Stop when aflt eval plateau reports stop=true.

phases.prompt: Do not edit any files. Do not switch to plan mode. Do not commit. The eval step runs hermetic `aflt eval measure`. Reply with the single word READY.

Do not edit any files. Do not switch to plan mode. Do not commit. The eval step scores the latest measure results and writes the improve baseline (eval/improve-baseline.json, maxRounds=3). Reply with the single word READY.

You are planning ONE improve round for aflt (self-improve loop).

Read-only context (do not modify these):
- Latest `aflt eval report` / eval/history.jsonl trend
- Human-owned eval/RUBRIC.md (criteria + RUBRIC GUARD)
- eval/improve-baseline.json (baseline overall + maxRounds)

Hard rules:
1. Propose at most ONE small, highest-value fix that includes tests.
2. Do NOT propose edits to eval/RUBRIC.md, scripts/eval/score.js, or scripts/eval/rubric.js.
3. Do NOT switch to plan mode. Do not commit/push/merge unless a phase onPass + loop allow flags explicitly enable it (this autonomous profile keeps allow.* false and plannedPhaseGate none).
4. Before proposing work, consider stopping: if `aflt eval plateau --json` would report stop=true (score plateau vs previous round/baseline, or rounds >= maxRounds, default 3), write { "done": true } and nothing else.

When continuing, write phases that implement exactly one fix then re-measure/score/gate. Prefer this shape (adapt ids per round):
1) build — implement the fix + tests (force true; eval: npm test or a focused node:test invocation; exitCode 0)
2) remasure — prompt READY only; eval: ["node","./bin/af.js","eval","measure","--json"] (long timeout)
3) rescore — prompt READY only; eval: ["node","./bin/af.js","eval","score","--json"]
4) improve-gate — prompt READY only; eval: ["node","./bin/af.js","eval","gate","--improve","--baseline","eval/improve-baseline.json","--json"] exitCode 0

Set gate to "none" on planned phases (autonomous profile). Keep onPass "none" unless the human sets allow.commit/merge/push to true — then the improve-gate phase may use onPass "commit" or "merge".

After a successful round, the runner returns here; either plan the next single fix or { "done": true } on plateau / max rounds / acceptance met.
